content: In the Hurufi Khwābnāma of Naṣr Allāh Nāfajī as summarized by MK, Khwāja Ṣadr al-Dīn Turka tells Fażl Allāh a dream in which he kissed the Prophet's hand and left saliva on it; Fażl Allāh reads it as meaning Ṣadr al-Dīn planned a book harmonizing religion and philosophy and should give it up rather than risk shame before the Prophet.
refers_to_primary: Nāfajī, Khwābnāma (Vatican MS Persian 17 ff. 32a-33a), via MK
